question.problem:
A sketch of the phase space with nullclines and the corresponding direction field of tangents to the solutions of a system of differential equations is shown below (the tangents are not drawn to scale). Sketch the trajectory of the solution starting at the marked point.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14118584/assets/0cf7942e618f0465ead5b98c6404a3747e505db75517725971c833c97121ab64.png)
question.worked_solution:
Let's sketch the trajectory.

- We start at the given point, moving along with the flow (downward and slightly to the right) until the trajectory intersects the $x$-nullcline, where the tangents are vertical.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14118584/assets/105bdbdcac5f0ff20f71a0131bf5bb3cbafe0e93ce8bc733a51c2dcb3fb8364f.png)

- Next, the flow continues downward, but the trajectory starts to turn slightly to the left.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14118584/assets/96757a3aee3b161b2ba9887cd85f977f063807779604647dd791cf265790cabc.png)

- After that, the trajectory continues to go downwards and slightly to the left to infinity.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14118584/assets/658c15d2291368d0e6836ba19b90157d49dee4a510d58cddf7f85ddc9ff72a8d.png)
